During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a '''communications station''' in [[Fara's Belt]] that was to be the target of a [[Raid on Fara's Belt|raid]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighters]]. However, the raid was compromised by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]], and the entire attacking force was destroyed.<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
